versions.changelog: Added a disk pre-check that a separate checker agent runs before any writer is spawned; The runtime has no host-independent tool-restricted agent type that still has a shell, and the checker needs g; Removed those overclaims; The in-place audit and the main-tree audit in worktree mode now diff against BASE_HEAD, recorded before any wr; The check script prints a git hash-object content hash with each changed path; Docs now match the code
No executable env fallbacks. realpath containment on the write allowlist.
Repo-relative writes enforced; no hardcoded spawn path; commit still double-opt-in.

Committing is now OFF by default and double-opt-in. Phase C rewrites git history, so it requires BOTH commit:true and confirmedCommit:true; passing commit:true alone logs a warning and runs apply-only. The description now states plainly that ORCA spawns subagents on your provider (which costs money), writes only to files you list, and does not commit unless asked twice.

Initial release. Lease-based parallel multi-file coding: Phase A drafts every unit's patch concurrently with no lease, Phase B applies them per-file-serialized so disjoint files run in parallel and shared files queue briefly, with automatic re-derivation of any patch that goes stale. Optional Phase C commits each unit separately, staging only that unit's files. All machine-specific paths are parameterized via args or ORCA_SPAWN_CLI / ORCA_CONDUCTOR / ORCA_OWNERSHIP_SCRIPT.
